description.value: Craigdarroch Castle is a National Historic Site and Victorian-era mansion built between 1887 and 1890 by Scottish-born coal baron Robert Dunsmuir, set on a hill overlooking the City of Victoria. Four floors of exquisite stained glass windows, intricate woodwork, and original Victorian furnishings immerse visitors in privileged 1890s British Columbia life. The castle also hosts travelling exhibits, educational programming, and an on-site gift shop, making it a landmark destination on any Victoria cycling itinerary.
